title: 花旗Matty Jiao：铜业公司估值重估，长期机会浮现？
speaker: Matty Jiao

segments.en: Yeah I mean almost it almost reversed completely I think we had this conversation 10 months ago it's as if we were talking about very very different company so about it given the that nothing has changed within 10 months say on the the supply constraints whether that's in copper or other places is this a good opportunity to look at these names again.
segments.zh: 是的，几乎完全反转了。我想我们10个月前有过这样的对话，就好像我们在谈论一家非常不同的公司。鉴于10个月内供应约束方面没有变化，比如铜或其他地方，这是否是重新审视这些公司的好机会？

segments.en: Yeah I think depending on how long you are talking about if in the next like you know a month I would say people will still be concerned on a lot of the macro issues right but if we are looking at like a year or a more longer run yes because a lot of these tight area like for example copper like Chinese copper name is now trading at about 8 times right global copper name is trading at 20 times at the beginning of the year China copper name is trading at 14 times.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为取决于你谈论的时间长短。如果是在接下来一个月，人们仍会担心很多宏观问题。但如果看一年或更长，是的，因为很多紧张领域，比如铜，中国铜企现在交易在约8倍，全球铜企年初为20倍，中国铜企为14倍。

segments.en: These are still the same copper companies right so I mean the big discount and then like the copper foil similarly six months ago they've been trading yeah they've been trading at like you know 2030 time now a lot of them is trading at low to mid teens so multiple has derated a lot but we haven't seen you know like copper foil or E glass or copper has resolved the tightness situation.
segments.zh: 这些仍是同样的铜公司，所以存在大幅折价。类似地，铜箔六个月前交易在20-30倍，现在很多在十几倍低至中段，倍数已大幅下降，但我们尚未看到铜箔、电子玻璃或铜解决紧张局面。

segments.en: If we want to look beyond like a three to six months risk then we think it's still the good opportunities.
segments.zh: 如果我们想看三到六个月以上的风险，我们认为这仍是好机会。

segments.en: Yeah what about when it comes to the oil names I mean if I see Brent at what.
segments.zh: 那么石油公司呢？比如布伦特原油在什么水平。
